sloka: पप्रच्छ कुशलम् राज्ञो यज्ञस्य च निरामयम् ।स ताम् च अथ मुनीन् पृष्ट्वा स उपाध्याय पुरोधसः ॥१-५०-९॥
transliteration: papraccha kuśalam rājño yajñasya ca nirāmayam ।sa tām ca atha munīn pṛṣṭvā sa upādhyāya purodhasaḥ ॥1-50-9॥

translations.english: Viswamitra duly enquired the wellbeing of the sages and the spiritual teachers, priests in right order. And thereafter the rest joined them in great delight.
